purpose: Define additive and breaking schema evolution, migration requirements and compatibility evidence without silently reinterpreting existing stored data or relation semantics.

value.additive_rule: Compatible additive fields/relations may preserve schema identity/version compatibility according to policy.
value.breaking_rule: Breaking semantic change requires explicit incompatible version/new identity where owning versioning policy requires.
value.migration_rule: Stored/instance data migration is explicit and separate from schema definition change.
value.field_rule: Field rename, split, merge, type change or semantic repurpose is explicitly mapped.
value.relation_rule: Relation/cardinality/FK changes are explicit compatibility/migration events.
value.default_rule: Adding a default does not silently backfill historical data unless migration explicitly does so.
value.evidence_rule: Compatibility/migration decision retains semantic diff and provenance.
